patch.longDescription:
Bay Ridge Ballet is a Bay Ridge dance school that says it has served the Brooklyn community since 2016 and offers year-round instruction in ballet plus other dance forms including tap, jazz, hip-hop, tumbling, and musical theater. The official baby-and-toddler page describes Move with Me as a 45-minute caregiver class for babies and toddlers using singing, musical instruments, and interactive games to build movement skills and confidence.

The official class descriptions and current schedule materials show offerings from baby-and-caregiver sessions through teen levels, with classes across weekdays and weekends that cover morning, afternoon, after-school, and evening time slots. Bay Ridge Ballet's current rates page lists a $20 registration fee per family and $395 tuition per semester for 16 classes, with multiple-class discounts and payment plans available for families registering for more than one class per semester.

The official location page lists Bay Ridge Ballet at 110 Bay Ridge Avenue, Brooklyn, NY 11220, with contact email info@bayridgeballet.com and phone 347-968-6905. ClassScout stores an ImgBB-hosted copy of the official Bay Ridge Ballet child-focused image from the provider's Wix media library for image-policy compliance.
